text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon visiting the cafeteria, 
I heard a heavy sigh nearby.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh............

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? 
Is something the matter, you two?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
!! Satono――!! 
Listen to this! Actually, this morning――

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Gwaark, gwaaark!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...!? No, Mambo! 
That's Grass's laundry!! Don't you dare touch――

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ――Aaaaggghhhhhhh~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And that's what happeneddddd...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Actually, with me too――

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me find my phone, 
Flash-san...! You saved my life――

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――Wait, is that the time!? 
I'm so sorry, you had plans, didn't you...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And that happened... 
I caused her so much trouble~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, roommate-specific troubles, isn't it? 
I can certainly relate to that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Like having Kita-chan stay up late chatting with me, 
or accidentally waking her up when I get up early...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si! I just can't help myself desu!
That's why I know I have to apologize, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I remember that messy pile of laundry,
it's so hard to bring it up...! Uggghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that's true.
If only we could create a good opportunity to apologize—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, come to think of it, that time—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that other time too—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Everyone, I have a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-Welcome desu—Grass!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks for coming—
Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! What's going on?
Everyone's gathered here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, welcome, Kita-chan!
We wanted everyone to enjoy a thank-you party♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right desu! Grass,
thanks for always taking care of me! And also—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —We're so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa and Smart Falcon both
apologized to their respective roommates
for causing them trouble.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Dancing the mambo? Fufu, isn't that just
your usual routine? Including apologizing like this♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am quite accustomed to it as well.
I adjusted my schedule immediately afterward.
Please do not worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Really desu ka!? Thank goodness...
Really!? Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like it worked out.
I'm so glad♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's making up...? Did you
host this party for their sake, Dia-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ I remembered when we all ate fried chicken together.
I thought this would be the best way
to convey their feelings♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, everyone! We've prepared plenty
of chicken and drinks.
Please enjoy yourselves to your heart's content♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I brought over some honey mustard~! 
Feel free to switch up the flavor☆

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We have salsa sauce too!
It's a special recipe passed down from my papa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For quite a while, the cafeteria was buzzing with
excitement and cheerful laughter echoing throughout.
